hook: GTA 6 just came out, and this guy already hooked up a PS5 Pro to an RTX 5090 PC and got *280 FPS on DLSS 5*
caption:
GTA 6 has barely launched, and someone has already pushed it to a reported 280 FPS using a PS5 Pro connected to a PC with an RTX 5090.
According to GameGPU, the setup uses a capture card and NeuralScreen software to apply NVIDIA's DLSS 5 and frame generation to the console's video output in real time.
The test reportedly reached 262-280 FPS at 4K, compared with the PS5 Pro's 30 FPS in the same scene. The extra frames were generated on the PC, meaning the game itself wasn't running at 280 FPS.

Video: via Instagram
